title: LLM-Enhanced Self-Evolving Reinforcement Learning for Multi-Step E-Commerce Payment Fraud Risk Detection
abstract: arXiv:2509.18719v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: This paper presents a novel approach to e-commerce payment fraud detection by integrating reinforcement learning (RL) with Large Language Models (LLMs). By framing transaction risk as a multi-step Markov Decision Process (MDP), RL optimizes risk detection across multiple payment stages. Crafting effective reward functions, essential for RL model success, typically requires significant human expertise due to the complexity and variability in design. LLMs, with their advanced reasoning and coding capabilities, are well-suited to refine these functions, offering improvements over traditional methods. Our approach leverages LLMs to iteratively enhance reward functions, achieving better fraud detection accuracy and demonstrating zero-shot capability. translated_title: 基于大语言模型增强的自进化强化学习用于多步骤电商支付欺诈风险检测
translated_abstract: 本文提出了一种将强化学习（RL）与大语言模型（LLM）相结合的电商支付欺诈检测新方法。通过将交易风险建模为多步骤马尔可夫决策过程（MDP），强化学习能够在多个支付阶段优化风险检测。设计有效的奖励函数是强化学习模型成功的关键，但由于设计的复杂性和多变性，通常需要大量的人类专业知识。大语言模型凭借其先进的推理和代码生成能力，非常适合改进这些奖励函数，相比传统方法具有明显优势。我们的方法利用大语言模型迭代地增强奖励函数，实现了更高的欺诈检测准确率，并展示了零样本能力。基于真实数据的实验通过长期评估证实了我们LLM增强强化学习框架的有效性、鲁棒性和韧性，凸显了大语言模型在推动该领域发展方面的潜力。
tldr: 该论文提出利用大语言模型迭代优化强化学习的奖励函数，并将支付欺诈检测建模为多步骤马尔可夫决策过程，从而显著提升电商支付欺诈检测的准确率并展现出零样本能力。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes leveraging LLMs to iteratively refine reward functions for reinforcement learning, framing payment fraud detection as a multi-step MDP to improve e-commerce fraud detection accuracy and demonstrate zero-shot capability.
